There is no per-target feedback setting. Every
registered target wants AI feedback by default,
and the instructor's test suite opts individual
targets out at run time by calling
ai_not_needed. A target she never wants
feedback on simply is not registered here.
The identifiers registered here are a
contract with her test suite.** She passes
these exact strings to ai_not_needed. Rename
one and her suite stops matching, so the API
rejects unknown names loudly. See OQ-12.
For the instructor guide: IMMEDIATE puts LLM
timeout, and submissions spike before a
deadline. Large courses should prefer NIGHTLY.
[for each method or class to grade]

Three columns tell the blank-looking cases
apart: ai_needed false means her suite opted
the target out; completed_at NULL with no
last_error means feedback is still coming;
last_error set means the attempt failed.

This is now mode-dependent, which makes it
harder than before. In nightly mode an
approval gate is possible between the marking
and the rerun. In immediate mode there is no
window: feedback reaches the student in the
same autograder run that generates it.
